title: ECS Cluster Health Pre-Restart Checklist
description: Run these checks BEFORE restarting any ECS service or node to avoid making things worse

checks.how: Call ecs:DescribeClusters and check registeredContainerInstancesCount vs runningTasksCount

thresholds.do_not_restart: capacity_pct < 20 – cluster is nearly full, restart will cause cascading failures

checks.how: Call ecs:DescribeServices for all services in the cluster

thresholds.caution: 1-2 other services in non-steady state – proceed with care
thresholds.stop: 3+ services degraded – cluster-wide issue, escalate immediately

checks.how: Check if a deployment happened in the last 10 minutes

thresholds.safe: no recent deployment – failure is organic
thresholds.caution: recent deployment – this crash may be caused by the new version, consider rollback instead of restart
